source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Ivory Coast 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Côte d'Ivoire crest on the left chest with three stars above, the Puma logo opposite on the right chest and on the shoulders, and a small flag detail on the upper back below the collar; no commercial sponsor on any placement, and the full kit is 'paired with coordinating orange shorts and socks'. Goal's kit round-up (2026) likewise describes only the design, crest and Puma branding.
source.quote: The Côte d’Ivoire crest is positioned on the left chest with three stars above, while the Puma logo sits opposite on the right chest and also appears on the shoulders.

summary: Puma home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle, released 24 March 2026. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the FIF crest with three stars, Puma branding on the chest and shoulders, and a flag detail on the upper back, with coordinating orange shorts and socks.
